children: Oracle has expanded Digital Assets Data Nexus to let banks process stablecoins, CBDCs, tokenized deposits, and other digital asset transactions directly within existing ISO 20022 payment systems, without building separate payment systems for each asset or blockchain. The capability is scheduled to launch in fiscal 2027.

According to Foresight News, the platform will support multi-chain ledgers, custodial wallets, smart contracts, and on-chain and off-chain workflows, and it will be pre-integrated with Oracle Banking Payments.

The new version will also connect to Swift Ledger to synchronize interbank payment commitments with tokenized deposit status, with final settlement completed through existing RTGS or correspondent banking networks. Oracle AI Database will be added to analyze anomalous transactions, liquidity stress, fraud, and AML risks, and it can trigger controlled actions such as freezing tokens, suspending accounts, and adjusting limits under human supervision.

title: Oracle Expands Digital Assets Data Nexus for Bank Payments and Tokenized Assets
